rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=60, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.02, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=800, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-12 REDO (breast ItNet v1). Prior iter-12 (ep100,a0.02) TIMED OUT 30:24 (repeating iter-10s at-the-wall ep100 profile overran). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: champion iter-10 (c16,tn800,ep100,a0.0) 0.8847 ~= iter-8 (ep60,a0.0) 0.8842 (tied, ep100 gain was noise); iter-11 (c24) 0.8543 width hurts. All alpha tests were at OLD tn400/weak denoiser; never re-probed with tn800. (2) FAILURE MODE: possible untested interior alpha optimum with the strong tn800 denoiser + budget overrun on ep100 -> use the SAFE ep60 profile (iter-8 ran 890s). (3) ONE KNOB vs iter-8 baseline: itnet_alpha 0.0 -> 0.02 (tn800, ep60, c16 all = iter-8). Clean single-knob alpha test at compute-safe profile. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if a tiny DC nudge helps the strong tn800 denoiser, hr rises above iter-8s 0.8842 because a small alpha adds sinogram consistency with minimal streak re-injection off a clean x_denoised. FALSIFIER: if hr<=0.8842, alpha=0 is optimal across denoiser strengths -> DC step unconditionally net-harmful on 128-view breast, alpha lever CLOSED. (5) BUDGET: ep60/tn800 = iter-8s 890s (well under wall); only float alpha changed. (6) Loop to iter-20.
